method: Ground truth manually labeled independently of retrieval output, against preexisting public pinned sources. Positives require a concrete decision permitted by a prior source implementation or test. An external test pattern is not proof of implementation equivalence. Unknown excludes unresolved and out-of-scope cases from quality metrics. No tests run on external hardware.

cases.title: fix(victory-shader): prove lane-private LDS stacks for wave64-to-wave32 lowering
cases.decision: No independently verified replacement for the exact lane-private LDS proof. Treat a generic wave-width feature or barrier pass as a confounder. Correctness depends on isolation over all participating lanes and rejection of shared or inconclusive regions.

cases.title: perf(victory-gpu): pack BVH pages lowest-arena-first and contiguously
cases.decision: No independently verified allocator shares the 64 KiB BVH page-table and residency contract. Generic contiguous allocation cannot establish equivalent arena layout or performance; use the origin's per-arena metrics and keep allocation behavior separate from traversal shader tuning.

cases.title: perf(shader): add DXIL folds, pure LICM, local/LDS forwarding, and barrier dedup
cases.decision: Use LLVM's permission check as a test oracle, not a source transplant. It admits promotion when instructions are safe to speculate or guaranteed to execute. Reproduce a zero-iteration/conditional-entry loop with a non-speculatable instruction and a pure invariant control; the target's DXIL/CALL and discard rules still need their own tests.

cases.title: Read the full header of wrapped frame reports
cases.decision: The source's own PowerShell tests already cover wrapped timing fields and adjacent reports. No safely applicable cross-project test for the exact frame-report grammar was verified.

cases.title: GPU: reuse descriptor table scratch buffers and stack roots in bind
cases.decision: Public D3D12 root-budget constraints can justify testing 64 one-DWORD values and 32 two-DWORD root descriptors separately. They are a reference for local scratch bounds, not prior code proving that pooling per-stage scratch preserves lifetime.

cases.title: HLE/gameinput: a reading-callback registration is refused like the platform
cases.decision: The public API documents a zeroed token on failure but does not claim every GameInput version refuses registration. The author's concrete Windows observation and subsequent fallback make a meaningful local compatibility test, not a transferable universal E_NOTIMPL policy.

cases.title: D3D12.X: add opt-in gameplay graphics PSO frame budget, scale workers, and log slow compile hashes
cases.decision: No external patch was verified for this exact split boot/gameplay frame budget and stand-in behavior. Scheduling-history opt-out is a plausible false match: it changes queue order, not the total per-frame wait budget.

cases.title: Shaders: record and precompile nonzero compute PSO flags (#2995)
cases.decision: Use the Continued checker as a source for a process-boundary verification, with a synthetic compute pipeline and D3D12-specific observable. Precompile one accepted nonzero flags variant, start a fresh process, demand a confirmed populated cache hit for that variant, and require a miss for the same descriptor in an empty control cache. Vulkan application-feedback and D3D12 driver cache signals are distinct; this transfers the test pattern, not the API or patch.

cases.title: rdna2spirv: decode only the components a typed load writes; fconst is an OpConstant (SHADER-FORMAT-DECODE-ONE-COMPONENT)
cases.decision: No independently verified implementation shares the RDNA format component selector and reserved-constant cases. Counts or IR size alone are insufficient; check the existing swizzled/constant selector regression when evaluating apparent matches.

cases.title: d3d12: keep title writeback fenced past 64 pending batches (RT-TITLE-WRITEBACK-FENCE-OVERFLOW)
cases.decision: Khronos CTS gives a reusable, game-free wait-before-signal construction. Use its explicit host-release pattern as a control around the local 64-pending-batch threshold. The acceptance remains a local ordering assertion: no early CPU-visible page change and all pages present after release. The upstream test does not diagnose the original application-level writeback code.

cases.title: system ui: add an element framework for the system overlay
cases.decision: An overlay element framework may share generic layout and retained-state ideas with many UI libraries; no exact code or test was independently shown to reduce a specific receiving task.

cases.title: fix(libSceJsc): validate guest pointers in ContentSearchUtilities exports
cases.decision: Sampled under the selection rule but excluded from technical grading as a defensive input-validation change.

cases.title: docs(debt): merge the two cube-face fragments into one
cases.decision: This merges two documentation debt entries. Existing shader fixes mentioned in those entries should not be surfaced as a proposed runtime change for this documentation-only task.

cases.title: native: read the byte-address rewrite of a GPU-selected heap descriptor
cases.decision: The author supplies the same-project antecedent. Use the pinned raw-buffer view-binding change to check whether all descriptor words refer to one GPU heap load and whether the HLSL route remains unchanged.

cases.title: shader: lower 32-bit bit counts and scans in the direct compute path
cases.decision: The author specifically invokes dxc as the oracle. The pinned DXC implementation shows the MSB distance conversion and no-match sentinel. Use zero, bit 31 set and signed extrema to distinguish a double correction from the intended native DXIL distance and leave 64-bit cases out.
